say:1:1123655001:1.text: The Quicksand Claws have become more aggressive lately. They even attempted to cross our borders and seize our land.
say:1:1123655001:1.source_cn: 流沙之爪最近越来越猖狂了，甚至想越过黑嚎氏族的边界，掠...

say:2:1123655002:1.text: Our warriors tried to chase them down, but they always managed to escape with their speed.
say:2:1123655002:1.source_cn: 我们的战士试图追击，但他们太过灵活，每一次都能顺利逃跑。

say:3:1123655003:1.text: We of the Grimmaw Clan are strong but not very fast. Pursuing them poses a challenge to us.
say:3:1123655003:1.source_cn: 黑嚎只擅长力量比拼，却不够灵活，实在难以追击。

say:4:1123655004:1.text: It'd be great if you could help us <style="highlight">patrol the borders</style>.
say:4:1123655004:1.male: It'd be great if you could help us <style="highlight">patrol the borders</style>.
say:4:1123655004:1.female: It'd be great if you could help us <style="highlight">patrol the borders</style>.
